preconditions.description: The number of queries is between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= typei <= 2 for typei, _ in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query type is either 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= current_vertex_count for _, vi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each vertex index in the queries is within the current range of existing vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output, float) for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output is a floating-point number.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= output <= current_height for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output is within the range [0, current_height].

invariants.description: The current vertex count matches the number of vertices in the tree.

invariants.expression: all(parent in vertices for parent in parents.values())
invariants.description: Each parent vertex in the tree exists.
